subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a second bootstrap authority that overrides the documented workspace, or should OpenClaw retain workspace-only authority and warn users about misplaced bootstrap files?
rationale: Both choices are technically implementable, but they establish different prompt-trust, upgrade, and safety contracts; source inspection cannot determine the intended permanent product boundary.

options.title: Keep workspace authority
options.body: Retain workspace-only bootstrap loading and add a warning or Doctor guidance for bootstrap-named files found in `agentDir`.

options.title: Adopt explicit dual authority
options.body: Allow explicitly configured `agentDir` files to override workspace files only after approving and documenting precedence, migration, security, and runtime-proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Keep workspace authority
recommendation.body: Retain workspace-only bootstrap loading and add a warning or Doctor guidance for bootstrap-named files found in `agentDir`.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to the documented agent-workspace contract and adjacent bootstrap lifecycle decisions.
